title: GPT-4o joins the text API
summary:
The text API gained a bigger model, more predictable request handling, and clearer paths for people using and contributing to it.

The new `openai-large` option adds GPT-4o chat and vision support, while `openai` remains GPT-4o-mini. The docs now show image analysis with URLs or base64 data, and web-search requests get a search-specific default prompt when callers do not supply one.

The configured text API limit rose from 20 to 40 requests per minute. Separately, text requests now enter a queue that starts them at least three seconds apart per IP group; addresses sharing an IPv4 /24-style prefix share that pacing. Request-delay and rate-limit bypass rules were also tightened.

Requested temperature now reaches the OpenAI generation path. Invalid messages receive JSON errors, empty message arrays receive a 400 response, and handling improved for missing query parameters and omitted generation options. Tracking, backend tests, and pull-request test coverage also improved.

Text API feed events no longer include requester IP addresses. It is a small change with a straightforward benefit: the feed needs the event, not the address behind it.
